report.clinical_summary: Patient diagnosed with HIV 3 years ago, currently on Triumeq daily but missing doses 2-3 times per week and taking drug holidays. Viral load is detectable at 340 copies/mL with CD4 count of 410 cells/uL. Reports fatigue and terrible headaches lasting the whole day after taking medication. Expresses uncertainty about whether medication is actually working and has concerns about future health complications.

terrible headaches after taking my medication, and they last the whole day
I'm scared about what might happen if my viral load keeps creeping up. I worry that it might lead to more serious health problems down the line
